ideas.idea: Use <Link to='/features'> instead of onClick div for the main CTA
ideas.why: This is the known /features div/onClick issue, but this is the same fix restated; it is accurate and concrete.

ideas.idea: Add a Features link to the root nav
ideas.why: The nav in root.tsx only lists Pricing and Changelog, so a real server-rendered link to /features on every page would help crawlers find it.

ideas.idea: List plan names, prices and inclusions on the pricing page
ideas.why: pricing.tsx has only a vague 'talk to us' line, so there is no concrete content for readers or machines to understand.

ideas.idea: Name the integrations in text on the home page, possibly with their own pages
ideas.why: The home page claims 'all the tools you already use' without naming any, so naming them gives readers and machines specific content.

ideas.idea: Expand the thin Features page with a section per feature
ideas.why: features.tsx has a single sentence, so more detail would help readers and machines understand the product.

ideas.idea: Add <lastmod> dates to the sitemap, especially for /changelog
ideas.why: It's accurate, but lastmod has little effect and applies to almost any sitemap.

ideas.idea: Add Organization/WebSite JSON-LD for site identity
ideas.why: It goes against the stated choice that having no JSON-LD is not a required fix.

ideas.idea: Generate the sitemap dynamically with a Remix resource route
ideas.why: With only four routes, a hand-kept sitemap is fine and the advice fits any site.

ideas.idea: Add charset, viewport and og/social tags to the root head
ideas.why: This is accurate for root.tsx, but it is standard advice for almost any site and has little effect on discovery.

ideas.idea: Give each changelog release its own URL
ideas.why: It is plausible, but it's speculative, would need a larger redesign, and the entries aren't even in server HTML yet.
